title: A delegated child's environment holds case-insensitive duplicate variable names, so PowerShell's Env: enumeration throws
outcome: On Windows, the environment TermAl builds for a spawned child holds each variable name once, compared without regard to case, so `Get-ChildItem Env:` and its filters work in every child.
acceptance: A delegated child's environment holds case-insensitive duplicate variable names, so PowerShell's Env: enumeration throws is done
disposal_reason: Duplicate. w-64b4f4cfde4e already tracks the same defect: spawned sessions carry environment keys differing only in case, so PowerShell's Env: enumeration throws. Engram::Opus's new occurrence (child session-9895) is recorded there.
